components.name: Paper Mill Button
components.description: Bordered small header button tinted rust; reads Close Mill while the editor is open.
components.css: .ds-mill { background:rgba(179,74,33,.12); color:#B34A21; border:0; border-radius:6px; padding:3px 8px; font:500 11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; }

components.name: Mode Tabs
components.description: Your desk and Paper library as equal-width buttons in a 3-point-padded track.
components.css: .ds-modes { display:flex; padding:3px; border-radius:8px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.045); } .ds-modes button { flex:1; border:0; background:transparent; padding:7px 0; border-radius:6px; font:400 12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; color:#1D1D1F; } .ds-modes button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#FFFFFF; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Library search; focus turns the icon and hairline to the system accent.
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08); border-radius:12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.9); color:#6E6E73; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color:rgba(0,122,255,.5); color:#007AFF; } .ds-search input { border:0; outline:0; flex:1; background:transparent; font:400 12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; color:#1D1D1F; }

components.name: Paper Sample
components.description: The 342 × 148-point desk sample: the paper itself with metadata, serif name, and subtitle.
components.css: .ds-sample { width:342px; height:148px; box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:16px; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12); border-radius:5px; background:#F4F1EA; color:#29241C; display:flex; flex-direction:column; } .ds-sample small { font:600 9px "SF Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:1.8px; } .ds-sample h2 { margin:auto 0 0; font:500 27px "New York",ui-serif,Georgia,serif; } .ds-sample p { margin:0; font:400 11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: Fixed-width library card: 92 × 52-point sample, name, and tag; selected cards add a rust wash, hairline, and checkmark.
components.css: .ds-paper-card { width:108px; padding:8px; display:grid; gap:8px; text-align:left; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08); border-radius:5px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.75); color:#1D1D1F; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; } .ds-paper-card[aria-pressed="true"] { border:1.5px solid #B34A21; background:rgba(179,74,33,.09); } .ds-swatch { height:52px; border-radius:3px; background:#F4F1EA; } .ds-paper-card strong { font:600 12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; } .ds-paper-card small { font:400 10px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; color:#6E6E73; }

components.name: Setup Card
components.description: Desk setup in a three-column grid; selected when the current settings match it.
components.css: .ds-setup { padding:9px; display:grid; gap:5px; text-align:left; border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.08); border-radius:6px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.035); font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; } .ds-setup[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color:rgba(179,74,33,.55); background:rgba(179,74,33,.08); } .ds-setup small { font:400 9px "SF Mono",ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-setup strong { font:500 12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; } .ds-setup span { font:400 9px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; color:#6E6E73; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category capsule (All, Light, Dark, My Papers); hidden while searching.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 10px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.06); color:#1D1D1F; font:400 11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; transition:background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-filter-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#B34A21; color:#FFFFFF; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Control Tab
components.description: Grain, Snooze, Displays, App Rules, Settings: icon plus full label in a horizontally scrolling row; the selected tab is centred.
components.css: .ds-control-tab { border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.04); border-radius:999px; padding:6px 10px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.06); color:#1D1D1F; font:500 11px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; transition:background-color 150ms ease-in-out; } .ds-control-tab[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#007AFF; border-color:rgba(0,122,255,.4); color:#FFFFFF; font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview:
Deckle is opened briefly while someone is reading, writing, or working across one or more displays. Its controls should feel like well-kept tools on a calm desk: familiar, precise, tactile, and ready to disappear as soon as the paper is chosen.

The interface is a restrained macOS product surface. System materials and semantic colors provide light/dark adaptation; Deckle Rust marks selection. Actual procedural paper samples carry the visual identity. Dense controls remain legible without turning the popover into a dashboard.

Deckle rejects ornamental glassmorphism, neon utility palettes, oversized marketing typography, nested card stacks, and motion that delays a task.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet neutral surfaces with one brand accent
Paper samples as the dominant visual material
Compact controls with explicit labels and state
One focused mode at a time instead of stacking every section vertically

rules.name: The One Mode Rule
rules.body: The menu shows exactly one of Your desk, Paper library, or Controls and settings. Searching and browsing live in Paper library; opening the controls replaces the current content rather than stacking a drawer over it.

rules.name: The Honest Material Rule
rules.body: The popover background is `windowBackgroundColor` at 96% opacity. Content surfaces inside it are opaque or strongly tonal. Empty translucent regions below the footer are a sizing bug.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Green means live or successful, orange means caution or snoozed, and red means destructive or heavy loss. Do not reuse them decoratively.

rules.name: The Stable Number Rule
rules.body: Every changing percentage, timer, count, and comfort metric uses monospaced or monospaced-digit typography so controls do not shift.

rules.name: The Native Voice Rule
rules.body: Buttons use sentence case and short verbs. Uppercase is reserved for the desk sample's metadata line.

dos: Do use the Apple system font and native semantic colors for controls; reserve the serif for the wordmark, paper names, and section headings.
Do keep the popover at 370 points with 14-point padding and spacing.
Do give every vertical `ScrollView` inside MenuBarExtra a deterministic viewport height.
Do keep card dimensions explicit: 108-point paper cards, 8-point gaps, three columns.
Do use monospaced digits for live percentages, countdowns, counts, and comfort metrics.
Do pair semantic color with a checkmark, label, or symbol.
Do make every item in a horizontally scrolling row reachable by clicking, and signal overflow.
Do keep Paper Mill comfort language factual and non-medical.
Do respect Reduce Motion for interface animations.
donts: Don't use `.frame(maxHeight:)` alone for a flexible grid inside MenuBarExtra. It may collapse while the window keeps translucent empty space.
Don't stack the desk, controls, and library in one vertical state.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism, gradient text, neon accents, or side-stripe borders.
Don't nest cards inside cards. Use spacing, dividers, and tonal groups before another container.
Don't use success, warning, or danger colors outside their semantic meaning.
Don't truncate control-tab labels to make them fit. Keep the tab row scrollable and signal overflow.
Don't leave blank material below the footer after a mode transition. If that occurs, the sizing contract is broken.
